blocks.title: 📖 I nearly died! (Liz Ellen)
blocks.html: One day last week, my mum and I were out shopping in town. We were looking for a present for my uncle, so we went to a gift shop. Mum saw a really nice mug on the shelf. ‘That’s nice,’ she said. ‘Your uncle will like that. He drinks lots of tea.’ I picked it up to look at the price and spilled hot coffee all over my dress. It was the shop assistant’s own mug! I was so embarrassed that I nearly died!

steps.lead: نستخدم الضمائر بدلاً من تكرار الأسماء، ونخمّن معنى الكلمة من السياق.

sentences: Last week, my dad took my sister and me to the museum.
We were looking at an old car and I wanted to ask Dad something.
I turned round, but he wasn’t there.
‘Dad! Dad!’ I shouted. I was worried.
Suddenly I saw him and ran towards him.
Bang! I ran into a big mirror.
